                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --series-1 · Composition series · root

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Fixed hues for the parts of a measured composition, one per part, so a part keeps its color between reports and every part a bar can hold stays distinguishable. A series hue carries no other meaning and is not a status tone. ---- Composition series (dark) ---- * One fixed hue per part of a measured composition (the /context bar), so * a part keeps its colour between reports and eleven of them can stand next * to each other. Ordered as the parts are usually drawn: the instructions * open with the theme's own accent, then the neutral inks, then the hues no * other surface in this theme uses. Each is legible on a dark card. ---- Composition series (light) ---- * The same eleven parts as the dark theme, each darkened so it holds its own * against a light card and stays a step apart from its neighbours.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --space-0-5 · Geometry · root

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Spacing, corner, control and reading geometry. Control radius is for page elements, overlay for floating surfaces, full for pills. Medium controls are the default; small suits dense per-item actions and large a primary call to action. ---- Spacing (spec §5.1) ---- * A 4px grid (--space-N is N × 4px) with two half-steps for the tight * spacing inside controls. Every gap, margin, and padding is one of these. * Two things are not spacing and stay literal: a 1px hairline, and geometry * that reserves room for something of a fixed size.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --terminal-bg-solid · Terminal · root

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Terminal palette roles in the shared theme. They describe colors, not terminal or process access. ---- Terminal ---- * Terminals follow the application theme: the surface and the ANSI palette * are swapped together (see src/ui/terminalTheme.ts), so a light-theme * terminal is dark-on-light rather than an unreadable island of * light-on-light. The ANSI colours are an intentional fixed palette per theme * — programs address them by index, so they cannot be derived from the shell * tokens — and each set is tuned for contrast on its own --terminal-bg. Light terminal: dark-on-light, with the ANSI palette darkened to hold AA * against the light surface.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --theme-seed · Accent and tones · root

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The seed recorded by the appearance projection. Runtime code derives a coherent accent ramp from it; changing this CSS property alone does not recompute the ramp or save a theme. ---- Accent (spec §2.5) ---- * * One theme colour, derived from the user's seed by src/ui/themeColor.ts * against the surface each shade lands on. src/ui/appearance.ts writes * these as inline custom properties, which override the values here; these * are the default seed (cherry blossom) already derived for this theme, so * the first paint is the right colour. * * accent-fill primary buttons, checked controls, count badges * text-on-accent the label on that fill (4.5:1) * accent-text links and accent text (4.5:1 on cards) * accent-indicator selection pills, underlines, progress (3:1 on cards)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --window-corner-radius · Host window · internal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Host frameless-window metrics or caption-button colors. Visible as stylesheet facts, but not a frame API for native resizing, window controls or shell layout. ---- Window frame ---- * The window is created frameless and transparent, so the app draws its own * border and corners. platform::window_frame asks the OS for the same * radius where it can, because CSS cannot round the native WebUI child view * composited over the page. Keep the two in step. * * 7px follows the corner Windows 11 draws for a top-level window * (DWMWCP_ROUND; the 4px DWMWCP_ROUNDSMALL is for menus and flyouts). * Nominally that is the 8px overlay radius, but drawn at 8 the frame's * border reads rounder than the corner DWM actually cuts, so the window * keeps its own step just under it. Matching it matters most on Windows, * where DWM owns the clip and picks the radius itself — a different value * here would draw this border inside or outside the corner the OS cuts. * * Both collapse when the window is maximized: a maximized window fills the * screen, and a radius there would show the desktop through its corners.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7px

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  :root, :root[data-theme="dark"]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  src/styles/tokens.css:508
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  --window-resize-grip · Host window · internal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Host frameless-window metrics or caption-button colors. Visible as stylesheet facts, but not a frame API for native resizing, window controls or shell layout. Grab depth for the frameless window's resize strips. * * Sized for the north edge, which is the hard one: the other three sit * against dead space, so a near-miss simply does nothing and the user tries * again. The top strip has the title bar's drag region immediately below it, * so a near-miss there *moves the window* instead — which reads as "the top * edge cannot be grabbed". One pixel is also spent on #app's own border * before the strip begins.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  8px

Window/shell roles describe host layout and do not give a frame authority over host windows. ---- Stacking ---- * * Two scales, chosen by where the element paints: * * --z-* planes of the whole window: the title bar, the window's resize * edges, and surfaces teleported to <body> (menus, dropdowns, * pickers, tooltips), which must clear everything in the shell * --layer-* shell surfaces inside .shell-body, below the title bar * * A literal z-index is allowed only to order a component's own children * inside its own stacking context, and stays within 0–3. The one exception * is TerminalScrollbar, which must clear xterm's internal layers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  useDirectionalTransition · function

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Pick the forward or backward variant of a directional transition to match the direction of travel. The forward variant brings the incoming screen in from the right, which reads as moving forward. Used for every switch it also makes going *back* to a screen on the left look like going forward again — the motion contradicts the navigation. This watches the active value's position in a known order and selects the mirrored backward variant when the user moves left. pattern names the transition (spec §9.4): axis for screens in a hierarchy or sequence, lateral for peer panels such as tabs. The watcher is pre-flush, so the name is settled before the render that actually swaps the element. @param active Currently selected value. @param order Values in the order they are presented, left to right. @param pattern Which directional transition to name.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  useDeferredPresence · function

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A surface the parent's state decides — a dialog for a pending deletion, a prompt, a decision — kept mounted until its own exit has run (spec §7.12, §9.4: a surface owns its exit). Unmounting a surface with v-if tears its transition down with it, so a commit that clears the parent's state would cut the dialog off mid-screen. Instead the parent mounts it while present, shows it while open, and lets it go when it reports that it has left: const deletion = useDeferredPresence( () => pendingDelete.value, () => (pendingDelete.value = null), ); <ConfirmDialog v-if="deletion.present" :open="deletion.open" :title="… deletion.value …" @close="deletion.closed" /> value is what the surface shows: the source's latest value, kept through the exit so the dialog does not empty as it fades. A source that holds again during the exit re-opens the same surface rather than letting it finish. clear empties the source. It runs when the surface closed on its own — a Cancel, Escape, or a smoke click — while the source still held, so the parent's state follows the user's answer. A required surface with nothing to clear omits it, and a source that still holds then mounts the surface again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  src/ui/useDeferredPresence.ts:43

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  扩展预设

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  此 schema 描述扩展贡献文件，不是用户预设存储中的 entry。结构默认值是 JSON 事实，TOML 没有 null 字面量；领域注解另行说明省略行为、有效默认和 catalog 可用性。

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Registered instance type id (<namespace>:<name>), never another preset. An unavailable base keeps this preset listed but unusable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • descriptionTextDocument | null可选Schema 默认 null

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Optional localized description.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • idstring必填未声明 Schema 默认

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      An extension's file names its preset; a user entry is named by its key.

Catalog validation rejects unknown fields, invalid values and secret fields; missing required fields remain for the user.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        至少满足一项:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        string
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        object

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      preset-extension-id · validation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      id

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      条件: Preset is contributed by an extension (not a user-store entry)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      要求: Supply id in extension preset files; user-store entries obtain their id from the store key.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      条件: Preset values are checked against the currently registered base type form

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      要求: Preset install and launch defaults must not include secret fields.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      扩展的设置表单、面板（info、table、log、actions、progress、status、list、markdown、empty、loading）、推送给面板和视图的界面状态、视图（frame）的加载方式、客户端接口、主题变量与安全限制，以及文字与多语言。
